title: SSPO: Structure-Aware Similarity-Weighted Preference Optimization for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.12443v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) relies on parallel solution sampling for training, yet existing methods fail to fully exploit the rich information latent in a co-sampled solution group. Preference-optimization methods anchor on the single best solution and discard fine-grained quality and structural signal from all other peers-a failure we term gradient signal polarization. Mean-based baselines instead weight peers uniformly, so structurally near-identical peers flood the baseline with redundant information and keep gradient variance high-a failure we term baseline redundancy. We propose SSPO (Structure-Aware Similarity-Weighted Preference Optimization), which scores all $B$ sampled solutions jointly through a dissimilarity-weighted leave-one-out baseline: structurally distinct peers receive higher weight, resolving both failures in a single mechanism. translated_title: SSPO：面向神经组合优化的结构感知相似度加权偏好优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12443v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：神经组合优化（NCO）依赖并行解采样进行训练，但现有方法未能充分利用协同采样解组中蕴含的丰富信息。偏好优化方法锚定于单个最优解，并丢弃来自其他所有同行的细粒度质量和结构信号——我们将这一缺陷称为梯度信号极化。基于均值的方法则统一加权所有同行，导致结构上近乎相同的同行用冗余信息淹没基线，并保持高梯度方差——我们将这一缺陷称为基线冗余。我们提出SSPO（结构感知相似度加权偏好优化），该方法通过一个相异度加权的留一法基线共同评分所有$B$个采样解：结构上不同的同行获得更高权重，从而在单一机制中解决上述两种缺陷。该基线使用零参数、问题自适应的解嵌入构建。
tldr: SSPO通过相异度加权的留一法基线，同时解决了神经组合优化中偏好优化的梯度信号极化和基线冗余问题，有效利用所有采样解的结构信息。
en_tdlr: SSPO addresses both gradient signal polarization and baseline redundancy in neural combinatorial optimization via a dissimilarity-weighted leave-one-out baseline, effectively leveraging structural information from all sampled solutions.
